uncovered_features.feature_name: Java 8 runtime support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Java 8 runtime is deprecated for deployment, while existing Java 8 applications remain running and continue receiving traffic; deprecated on 2026-03-02.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Java 25 runtime
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Java 25 runtime is now generally available in App Engine standard environment; The Java 25 runtime is available in Preview for App Engine standard environment.

uncovered_features.feature_name: TLS 1.2+ and secure cipher suite support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine standard environment now supports TLS version 1.2 and later with a corresponding secure set of cipher suites.

uncovered_features.feature_name: TLS 1.1 and earlier support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Support for TLS versions 1.1 and earlier is deprecated, and applications should move to TLS 1.2+ with secure cipher suites; deprecated on March 2025.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Default max instances for automatic scaling in new projects
uncovered_features.feature_summary: For App Engine standard environment projects created after March 2025, the default automatic-scaling max_instances is set to 20 unless overridden at deployment.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine version filtering by runtime lifecycle stage
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine versions view in the Google Cloud console now supports filtering by runtime lifecycle stage and displays warning icons for runtimes nearing or past support milestones.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Maven wrapper support for App Engine Java
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Java runtime now supports managing project Maven dependencies using Maven wrappers.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine Java release artifact distribution model by version
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine Java released artifacts now use the open source release mechanism for 2.x.x versions, while 1.9.9xx and earlier use the internal build system.

uncovered_features.feature_name: User-managed service account per App Engine version
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Deployment now supports assigning a user-managed service account to each App Engine version in preview.

uncovered_features.feature_name: and asia-east1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the us-west1, asia-southeast1, and asia-east1 regions.

uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine standard environment introduced a CPU Utilization metric that reports average CPU utilization across active instances.
